mainEntity.name: What happens during a bathroom accessibility remodel?

acceptedAnswer.text: The process usually starts with a consultation, then a design plan, material selection, permitting if needed, and the actual construction. Common accessibility updates include grab bars, a walk-in or roll-in shower, a comfort-height toilet, wider doorways, better flooring, and improved lighting.
acceptedAnswer.description: Expect a consult, a plan, material choices, any needed permits, and then installation of safety and access features like grab bars, shower changes, and improved flooring.
